factors.reason_template: Water is {value} C, inside preferred Pacific temperature range for soupfin shark.
factors.value_notes: WDFW and CDFW describe soupfin sharks as temperate/cold-temperate and migratory, but reviewed sources do not establish a numeric preferred SST interval. The configured 11-20 °C range and 13-18 °C ideal remain unsupported by a species-specific SST preference curve; keep values unchanged and mark needs_source.

factors.reason_template: Depth is {value} m, within prime Pacific depth zone for soupfin shark.
factors.value_notes: WDFW reports soupfin sharks from muddy shallows to more than 411 m, with females most common shallower than 55 m and males generally deeper. CDFG describes sex- and region-specific patterns: southern California females are predominantly shallower than about 37 m, while northern California males are commonly deeper than 37 m. The configured 5-100 m band is not a universal preference and needs sex/region context.
